messages:
mae: Quick heads up — seeing a reproducible memory regression on runtime v2.15.4 during nightshift canaries in eu-west. Resident memory up ~12% on longseq jobs and one OOM in staging. Can we request a temporary pin back to v2.15.3 scoped to the nightshift window while we triage?

devon: can you paste the failed pod logs / flamegraph?

mae: sure. minimal trace: `AllocCache::grow()` hot, kernel commit 0x2f4b looks suspicious. sample logs: ```OOM killed process pid=3241 rss=28G vms=38G backtrace: ...``` Link to perf sample: https://perf.internal/runs/8472

ash: ran a quick local replay against the same model with `--long-seq` and I can reproduce the mem bump. the change in 2.15.4 to the attention kernel seems to increase peak allocs for long prefix workloads.

tj: scope question — is this isolated to eu-west nightshift or broader?

mae: primarily nightshift batch jobs (00:00-06:00 UTC) in eu-west and a tiny cohort in ap-south. Hosted realtime traffic unaffected so far.

deploybot: FYI to create a scoped pin use:`/deploybot pin --target runtime --version 2.15.3 --scope region:eu-west,ap-south --window 2024-08-14T00:00Z/2024-08-15T06:00Z --reason "nightshift mem regression"`

mae: thanks — I can open the request but want ops + release sign-off before we actuate.

sarah: I can approve an emergency slimline pin for the nightshift window if we attach clear rollback/runbook criteria. propose: rollback if OOM rate does not drop >80% in the first 2 hours or if tail latency >10% of baseline on streaming smoke tests. Also add a telemetry alert for memory-resident >+8% sustained for 30m.

devon: agree. will run a targeted canary for the streaming code path and smoke perf (small batch of 50 longseq requests) once the pin is provisioned.

mae: creating the deploybot request now and kicking off the canary. pasted command I used: ```/deploybot pin create --target=runtime --version=2.15.3 --regions=eu-west,ap-south --until=2024-08-15T06:00Z --note="nightshift mem regression - scoped"```

releasebot: Reminder: please update the release notes and changelog with a short entry: "temporary pin to runtime v2.15.3 for nightshift jobs to mitigate memory regression observed in v2.15.4" and tag `eng-releases`. This helps FYI for SRE and CS.

ash: I'll prepare a revert PR for the attention kernel change in 2.15.4 as a hotpatch candidate. ETA ~2h after we confirm repro on canary.

mae: if the canary shows no improvement we will escalate to rollback. I'll also capture the perf diffs and open a quick postmortem if OOMs persist after pin.

sarah: approved :thumbsup: I've signaled ops to watch the telemetry and enabled the memory alert. I toggled the draft pin in deploybot, waiting for ops heartbeat to enact.

deploybot: Pin request PB-3421 created by mae. Scope: runtime v2.15.3 -> regions [eu-west, ap-south], window 2024-08-14T00:00Z to 2024-08-15T06:00Z. Assigned: mae, ash, devon. Status: awaiting ops heartbeat.

tj: I'll be on watch for the next 3 hours and will post updates in this thread. call me if we need rapid rollback.

mae: thanks everyone — will post canary perf link in 15m. If things look good we'll let the pin quietly expire at window end; otherwise we'll iterate on the kernel revert.

releasebot: Logged note PB-3421 -> changelog updated.

devon: canary perf link: https://perf.internal/runs/8480 — early signal: mem delta -7% on the pinned nodes, OOMs resolved in the sample run. continuing watch.

mae: great, keeping thread pinned.

sarah: moving to monitoring, stand by for any alerts. :eyes:
